name: provenance-check
description: Check Ventura Roadmap references and borrowed structures for accurate attribution and license boundaries. Use when external roadmaps courses or competency frameworks influence a change. Do not use when the change is entirely original sequencing with no external source dependency.

# Provenance check

- Identify external roadmaps frameworks or curricula influencing the change.
- Distinguish inspiration from copied or adapted structure.
- Read `PROVENANCE.md` when present and keep it aligned.
- Record required attribution or license terms for derived material.
- Remove affiliation or certification implications not supported by evidence.
- Prefer independent wording and links when copying is unnecessary.
